audience: Engineers who use a coding agent and have felt it grep the same strange codebase over and over without ever understanding how the pieces connect.
single_takeaway: graphify turns your codebase into a real graph you can ask questions of, so instead of grepping you get back an actual path.
viewer_action: star the repo and try /graphify on their own codebase
desired_feeling: the quiet relief of finally being able to ask your code a question and get a straight answer
mandatories: graphify-native green-on-dark tokens (mined --bg and --accent), CC BY music attribution, creator @safishamsii tagged
success_criteria: Safi quote-posts it because it shows his tool answering a question in his own colors; the story reads fully muted
